problem: Fidelity. Wisdom 3:1 speaks of the righteous after they have died (the chapter goes on: in the sight of the unwise they seemed to die), and the sister card 4774 reads it that way, as the dead kept and asleep in the Father's hand. This note turns it into what sustained the living sons of Zebedee while they suffered, and 'no torment reaches them there' sits directly beside James being put to the sword, which is a torment that plainly did reach him.
quote: The cup was real suffering, and Wisdom tells what held them while they drank it: the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah (God), and no torment reaches them there.
fix: The cup was real suffering, and Wisdom tells where it ends: the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah (God), and there no torment touches them. James drank the cup to the bottom and lies down in that hand, kept and asleep until the Father raises him; the sword reached his body and could not follow him there.

problem: Fidelity (speaker). In 2 Esdras 13 the one interpreting the vision speaks of 'my Son' (13:32, 13:37), so the speaker is the Most High, and the sister card 4818 treats him that way. This note hands the same speech to 'the angel'.
quote: Ezra asks about the peaceable multitude the man from the sea gathers to himself, and the angel tells him outright who they are: the ten tribes carried out of their own land by Salmanasar of Assyria and taken over the waters into another land.
fix: Ezra asks about the peaceable multitude the man from the sea gathers to himself, and the Most High tells him outright who they are: the ten tribes carried out of their own land by Salmanasar of Assyria and taken over the waters into another land.

problem: Fidelity. Revelation 20:10 says the devil is cast into the lake 'where the beast and the false prophet are'; they were already there from 19:20, so the devil is not received 'first'. Neither quoted verse says anything about the order of who enters the lake.
quote: Notice what the King says about the fire: it was prepared for the devil and his angels, the fallen ones Jude and Peter say are kept in chains for judgment (Jude 6; 2 Peter 2:4), and the lake in Revelation 20:10 receives the devil first.
fix: Notice what the King says about the fire: it was prepared for the devil and his angels, the fallen ones Jude and Peter say are kept in chains for judgment (Jude 6; 2 Peter 2:4), and John sees the devil himself cast into that lake of fire (Revelation 20:10).
